caption: Opening page of Prentiss and Morgan's "Anhalonium Lewinii (Mescal Buttons)" in the Therapeutic Gazette, September 16, 1895.
alt: Front page of the Therapeutic Gazette issue, showing the masthead, full table of contents, and the start of the article by D. W. Prentiss and Francis P. Morgan, including the sentence naming James Mooney as the source of the mescal buttons.
credit: Internet Archive / Therapeutic Gazette, vol. 19, no. 9 (Sept. 16, 1895)
note: Leaf 0 of the single-issue scan (item sim_therapeutic-gazette_1895-09-16_19_9), which combines the issue's masthead/contents with the opening of the article on the same physical page. Located via the search-inside API for "Anhalonium".
